Claire Morton: Heads-up — new compact OKR + Self-Review pack is live in the handbook. Short sheet, examples, and a manager cheat sheet. Please review with your teams this week: https://redwood.docs.internal/people/okr-pack-compact (internal only).
Devon Rivera: Thanks Claire. Quick Q: should individual goals be measurable or can we have growth/learning goals that are softer?
Claire Morton: Both. We expect 1-3 individual objectives. If an objective is qualitative (e.g., "improve cross-team collaboration"), add 1-2 measurable proxies in the KR (meeting cadence established, number of docs published, stakeholder satisfaction score).
Maya Singh: Can we see a filled example for an IC and a manager? Helps folks who get stuck.
Claire Morton: Added two examples — IC and L3 manager. IC example uses metrics (release-to-production time down 20%, mean time to rollback reduced), manager example focuses on team health + delivery outcomes.
Devon Rivera: For self-reviews, do we require numerical ratings or just narrative?
Claire Morton: Narrative + optional 1-5 rating for calibration. The form includes fields: accomplishments (bullets + links), evidence links (PRs, dashboards), biggest learning, blockers, and what help is needed. Managers should comment inline, not rewrite.
Ethan Brooks: How will calibration be run? I want to avoid score drift between teams.
HR-bot: Calibration sessions scheduled: Week of 2026-04-20. People Ops will send anonymized writeups and a short rubric. Managers should bring 3 examples from their directs.
Maya Singh: Can we get a short 30-minute "writing measurable KRs" drop-in before submissions?
Claire Morton: Yes — scheduling that next Wednesday; invite will go out. Also adding a 1-page checklist for managers: prep 1:1s, bring examples, agree on cross-team anchors.
Devon Rivera: One more — can teams request an exception for cycle dates if we have late hires?
HR-bot: Exceptions possible. Submit requests to people-ops@redwood.com with hire date and reason by 2026-04-10.
Claire Morton: Thanks everyone. Please open PRs on the doc if you have wording tweaks, or DM me. :pray:
